Sending calendar invite now with the attached agenda (TDX_agenda_v1.pdf) and a short answers doc for the two asks Amy raised: KV_cache_behavior.txt (summary) and KMS_handling_notes.txt. High level answers:

- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed KMS is supported in Private and Dedicated modes via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS and partner HSM workflows). We’ll list required artifacts for procurement.
